name: GroupedDocumentPublisherAccessProviderTestPlan
title: Grouped Document Publisher/Access Provider Test Plan
description:
Test plan for the **Grouped Document Publisher/Access Provider** actor of [EU Health Data API, 1.0.0-ballot](https://build.fhir.org/ig/euridice-org/eu-health-data-api/).
The SUT produces and serves its own documents; only the read side is external.
Each `suite` below is a `Rule:` of the Gherkin feature named by `suite.input.file`, and each `suite.test` one of its `Scenario:` lines, matched by the scenario's identifier. The assertions are the scenario's `Then` steps, verbatim.
The tests declare which specification obligations they cover (20 requirement paths named by the feature tags).
Fixture prerequisites, input bindings and expected data are in tests/fixtures/provider-v1/manifest.json, keyed by scenario ID. See the Testing page, Fixture contract and expected results. Provider fixtures are R4; client workflows use the canned data embedded in their feature.
purpose: To declare, in a machine-readable and runnable form, which behaviours a system claiming conformance to the Grouped Document Publisher/Access Provider actor must demonstrate.
